title: Fast and Accurate Domain Adaptation for Irregular Tensor Decomposition

problem.claim: Quickly and accurately capture patterns in an irregular tensor from a newly emerging domain by utilizing existing irregular tensors from multiple domains.

gap.claim: Previous PARAFAC2-based works cannot adaptably handle newly emerging target tensors using source tensors.

contributions.claim: A domain-adaptation approach for analyzing newly emerging irregular target tensors using existing source tensors is indicated.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper asks how to quickly and accurately capture patterns in a newly emerging irregular tensor using irregular tensors from multiple domains.
The problem matters for tasks such as finding patterns of a new disease from pre-existing disease data.
New target tensors have limited information because they have recently emerged.
Careful use of existing source tensors is presented as helpful, and PARAFAC2 is identified as a tool for finding patterns in irregular tensors.
Previous PARAFAC2-based work is described as unable to adaptably use source tensors for newly emerging target tensors.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the proposed algorithm or adaptation mechanism.
The abstract does not report experiments, datasets, baselines, quantitative results, or computational costs.
